definitions.explanation: The country, school, or institution where one goes to study abroad.

examples.japanese: {留学先|りゅうがくさき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: To decide on a study abroad destination.

examples.japanese: {留学先|りゅうがくさき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦アメリカ→アメリカ：01769_amerika⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧です。
examples.english: My study abroad destination is a university in America.

examples.japanese: {留学先|りゅうがくさき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できて→できる：00557_dekiru⟧、⟦{貴重|きちょう}→貴重：00223_kichou⟧な⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧になった。
examples.english: I made many friends at my study abroad destination, and it was a valuable experience.

notes:
{留学先|りゅうがくさき} is a compound of ⟦{留学|りゅうがく}→留学：03677_ryuugaku⟧ (study abroad) and ⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ (destination).
